block.managarden.mana_greenhouse.tip: Grows up to 8 generating flowers inside, with no fuel or care, and stores their mana
item.managarden.greenhouse_heart.tip: The living core of a Mana Greenhouse
item.managarden.upgrade_base.tip: Inscribed with runes on a Runic Altar, it becomes a greenhouse upgrade
item.managarden.upgrade.tip.luck: Each one: +%s chance of a lucky cycle with extra mana
item.managarden.upgrade.max: Goes into a Mana Greenhouse; up to %s of a kind count
gui.managarden.status.full: Stopped: the mana store is full
gui.managarden.redstone.high: Works only with a redstone signal
gui.managarden.redstone.low: Works only without a redstone signal
gui.managarden.output.on: Gives mana to pools, spreaders and other mana receivers next to it
gui.managarden.output.none: Nothing to give mana to: put a mana pool next to it or bind one
gui.managarden.output.bind: Wand of the Forest (bind mode): Shift+right-click the greenhouse, then a pool or spreader, to bind it
gui.managarden.output.bound: Bound with the Wand of the Forest. Shift+click here to unbind
gui.managarden.slot.flower.tip: Plant a generating flower: Endoflame, Hydroangeas, Thermalily, Rosa Arcana...
gui.managarden.slot.upgrade.tip: Growth, Reservoir, Fortune or Abundance upgrades, up to %s of a kind
gui.managarden.slot.charge: Put a mana tablet, mirror or ring here to charge it
gui.managarden.keeper.no_flowers: The beds are empty... plant some generating flowers, please!
gui.managarden.keeper.full: The store is full! Put a mana pool next to it, or add a Reservoir Upgrade.
gui.managarden.keeper.redstone: Redstone told us to rest. Check the lever!
gui.managarden.keeper.tip0: Different kinds of flowers grow better together: that's harmony!
gui.managarden.keeper.tip1: Fortune Upgrades make some cycles bloom with extra mana.
gui.managarden.keeper.tip2: Bind me to a mana pool with the Wand of the Forest and I'll fill it.
gui.managarden.keeper.tip3: Put a mana tablet in the blue slot and I'll charge it for you.
gui.managarden.keeper.tip4: Growth Upgrades make the flowers grow faster. Zoom!
gui.managarden.keeper.tip5: No fuel, no water, no fuss: just love and mana~
managarden.lexicon.greenhouse0: The $(item)Mana Greenhouse$() is a little house of glass and livingwood in which up to eight $(thing)generating flowers$() grow with no fuel, no water and no care at all.$(br2)It gathers the mana they make in a store of its own and hands it on.
managarden.lexicon.greenhouse1: Plant generating flowers in the eight beds round its mana heart. Every $(thing)cycle$() (five seconds) the flowers make mana, each as much as it would at its best, and together they grow better still: every kind of flower past the first adds 5 percent of $(thing)harmony$().
managarden.lexicon.greenhouse2: The mana flows on into $(item)mana pools$(), $(item)spreaders$() and other receivers right next to it, or into one bound to it: touch the greenhouse with the $(l:botania:basics/wand)Wand of the Forest$(/l) in bind mode, then the receiver.
managarden.lexicon.greenhouse3: The blue slot on the right charges $(item)mana tablets$(), mirrors and rings. The buttons in its window set how it heeds $(thing)redstone$() and whether it gives its mana away, and a $(item)comparator$() reads how full it is.$(br2)Its keeper will gladly tell you what it needs.
managarden.lexicon.greenhouse4: The $(item)Heart of the Greenhouse$() is born on the $(l:botania:basics/terrasteel)Terrestrial Agglomeration Plate$(/l).
managarden.lexicon.upgrades0: A greenhouse takes four $(item)upgrades$() in the slots on the left of its window. Upgrades of a kind stack, and up to eight of a kind count.$(br2)They are made from a $(item)Blank Floral Tablet$() on the $(l:botania:basics/rune_altar)Runic Altar$(/l).
managarden.lexicon.upgrades2: $(item)Growth$(): each one makes the cycles a quarter faster.
managarden.lexicon.upgrades3: $(item)Reservoir$(): each one makes room for 350 000 more mana.
managarden.lexicon.upgrades4: $(item)Fortune$(): each one gives a cycle one more chance in ten to be lucky and bring half as much mana again.
managarden.lexicon.upgrades5: $(item)Abundance$(): each one makes every cycle bring 15 percent more mana.
